crossRefs.note: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”
Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob…
The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him…
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink…
Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy…
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…

translations.web: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
translations.bsb: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
translations.kjv: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
translations.asv: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.
